Class AotLayout

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.AotLayout
public final class AotLayout extends Object
Writes the extracted layout of a Runner JAR, the deployment a JDK AOT cache serves in full: an application JAR whose manifest Class-Path lists lib/*.jar in class-path order, and the dependencies under lib/, byte for byte the JARs the Runner JAR nests.

The layout is what java -Dmicronaut.runner.mode=extract writes, forked with the java the cache is trained with, so the build runs exactly the path a user runs and keeps its own JVM clean. Every file carries the modification time 1980-02-01T00:00:00Z, so a layout copied with its times kept, or extracted again from the same JAR, still matches a cache trained on it.

Since:
1.0

  • Method Details

    • write

      public static AotLayout.Result write(Path java, Path runnerJar, Path destination, Duration timeout) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Extracts a Runner JAR into a directory, replacing what the directory held, and verifies the result.
      Parameters:
      java - the java executable that runs the extraction; a relative path is resolved against this JVM's working directory
      runnerJar - the Runner JAR
      destination - the directory, which is replaced as a whole
      timeout - how long the extraction may take
      Returns:
      the application JAR and the dependencies, in class-path order
      Throws:
      IOException - if the extraction fails or times out, or its output does not verify
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted; the extraction has been killed by then

    • verify

      public static AotLayout.Result verify(Path destination, Path runnerJar) throws IOException
      Checks a layout against the Runner JAR it was extracted from: the application JAR's Class-Path names lib/ plus each dependency's file name, in index order, and the application JAR and every file under lib/ carry FILE_TIME. A JDK AOT cache validates both.
      Parameters:
      destination - the layout
      runnerJar - the Runner JAR
      Returns:
      the application JAR and the dependencies, in class-path order
      Throws:
      IOException - if the layout does not match; the message names the first offending entry
